easy: Good enough to be given your time or attention.

ex.en: This book is worth reading twice.
ex.ko: 이 책은 두 번 읽을 가치가 있다.

easy: Having a certain amount of money value.

ex.en: This old baseball card is worth ten dollars.
ex.ko: 이 오래된 야구 카드는 10달러의 가치가 있다.

easy: The amount of something you can get for a set price.

ex.en: I bought five dollars' worth of candy.
ex.ko: 나는 5달러어치 사탕을 샀다.

easy: A little cold in a nice way, not hot.

ex.en: The cool breeze felt great after soccer practice.
ex.ko: 축구 연습 후에 시원한 바람이 정말 좋았다.

easy: Staying calm and not getting upset, even when things are hard.

ex.en: Mia stayed cool even when the big dog ran at her.
ex.ko: 큰 개가 달려와도 미아는 침착했다.

easy: A color that makes you think of ice and water, like blue or green.

ex.en: Blue and green are cool colors.
ex.ko: 파랑과 초록은 차가운 색이다.

easy: The person who tells the actors what to do in a play or movie.

ex.en: The director told the actors to speak louder.
ex.ko: 감독은 배우들에게 더 크게 말하라고 했다.

easy: In a way that is just right, with no mistakes.

ex.en: I put the cup exactly in the middle of the table.
ex.ko: 나는 컵을 탁자 한가운데에 정확히 놓았다.

easy: In a careful way, with no mistakes.

ex.en: Tom explained the rules exactly, so nobody was confused.
ex.ko: 톰이 규칙을 정확하게 설명해서 아무도 헷갈리지 않았다.

easy: When you hand something to someone to be nice.

ex.en: Giving presents makes my little sister happy.
ex.ko: 선물을 주는 것은 내 여동생을 행복하게 한다.

easy: Handing over money or things to help others, asking for nothing back.

ex.en: Giving to the food bank helps many families.
ex.ko: 푸드뱅크에 기부하면 많은 가족에게 도움이 된다.

easy: The hard part of the earth that you walk on, not the sea.

ex.en: After the long boat ride, we were happy to stand on dry ground.
ex.ko: 긴 배 여행 뒤에 우리는 땅을 밟아 기뻤다.

easy: A good reason for what you think or do.

ex.en: We have good grounds to think it will rain, because the clouds are dark.
ex.ko: 구름이 어두워서 비가 올 거라고 생각할 만한 근거가 있다.

easy: The soft brown stuff outside that plants grow in.

ex.en: We dug a hole in the soft ground to plant a seed.
ex.ko: 우리는 부드러운 땅에 구멍을 파서 씨앗을 심었다.

easy: A time when people come together to talk and plan.

ex.en: Dad has a meeting at work every Monday morning.
ex.ko: 아빠는 매주 월요일 아침마다 회사에서 회의가 있다.

easy: A small, friendly time when people get together.

ex.en: We had a small meeting at my house to plan the party.
ex.ko: 우리는 파티를 계획하려고 우리 집에서 작은 모임을 가졌다.

easy: When you run into someone by chance or see them for the first time.

ex.en: My first meeting with my new teacher was fun.
ex.ko: 새 선생님과의 첫 만남은 즐거웠다.

easy: To give people something they need or can use.

ex.en: The school provides lunch for every student.
ex.ko: 학교는 모든 학생에게 점심을 제공한다.

easy: To give food or other things that people need.

ex.en: Grandma provided snacks for the whole team.
ex.ko: 할머니는 팀 전체를 위해 간식을 마련해 주셨다.

easy: The way two or more people are connected to each other.

ex.en: My brother and I have a good relationship.
ex.ko: 형과 나는 사이가 좋다.

easy: A close bond between two people.

ex.en: Jin has a close relationship with his grandmother.
ex.ko: 진이는 할머니와 가까운 사이이다.

easy: The way two groups or countries get along with each other.

ex.en: The two countries have a friendly relationship.
ex.ko: 그 두 나라는 우호적인 관계를 맺고 있다.

easy: The ninth month of the year, when school usually starts.

ex.en: School starts again in September.
ex.ko: 학교는 9월에 다시 시작한다.

easy: Most of the time, the way things normally go.

ex.en: I usually eat breakfast at seven o'clock.
ex.ko: 나는 보통 7시에 아침을 먹는다.

easy: A number that you find or are given in math.

ex.en: The value of x in this math problem is five.
ex.ko: 이 수학 문제에서 x의 값은 5이다.

easy: How useful or important something is to you.

ex.en: Old photos have great value to my family.
ex.ko: 오래된 사진은 우리 가족에게 큰 가치가 있다.

easy: How much money something is worth.

ex.en: The value of this old coin is ten dollars.
ex.ko: 이 오래된 동전의 값어치는 10달러이다.

easy: To go after someone or something by moving behind it.

ex.en: My puppy follows me everywhere.
ex.ko: 우리 강아지는 어디든 나를 따라온다.

easy: To come after something else in time.

ex.en: Summer vacation follows the last day of school.
ex.ko: 여름방학은 학교 마지막 날 다음에 온다.

easy: Allowed by someone in charge, like a teacher or a leader.

ex.en: We need official permission from the teacher to go outside.
ex.ko: 밖에 나가려면 선생님의 공식 허락이 필요하다.

easy: Checked and said to be true by the people in charge.

ex.en: The score is official: our team won.
ex.ko: 점수가 공식으로 확정됐다. 우리 팀이 이겼다.

easy: A word you say to show you agree or are ready to go on.

ex.en: Okay, let's start the game.
ex.ko: 좋아, 게임을 시작하자.

easy: The making of things, like in a factory.

ex.en: The factory's production of toys goes up before the holidays.
ex.ko: 그 공장의 장난감 생산은 휴일 전에 늘어난다.

easy: A play or show that people come to watch.

ex.en: Our class put on a production of Peter Pan.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 피터 팬 연극을 공연했다.

easy: How fast something happens or moves.

ex.en: The snail moves at a very slow rate.
ex.ko: 달팽이는 아주 느린 속도로 움직인다.

easy: How much money you pay for something.

ex.en: The rate to get into the zoo is ten dollars.
ex.ko: 동물원 입장 요금은 10달러이다.

easy: How fast you do something or move along.

ex.en: Walk at a slow rate so little legs can keep up.
ex.ko: 어린아이들이 따라올 수 있게 천천히 걸어라.

easy: Looking at words and understanding what they say.

ex.en: Reading is my favorite thing to do on rainy days.
ex.ko: 비 오는 날에는 독서가 내가 가장 좋아하는 일이다.

easy: To keep someone or something from being hurt or lost.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved the boy from the waves.
ex.ko: 구조대원이 파도에서 그 소년을 구했다.

easy: To keep something for later or for a special reason.

ex.en: I saved my first lost tooth in a small box.
ex.ko: 나는 처음 빠진 이를 작은 상자에 간직했다.

easy: To bring someone to a safe place.

ex.en: Firefighters saved the kitten from the tree.
ex.ko: 소방관들이 나무 위의 새끼 고양이를 구했다.

easy: A thing that holds something up.

ex.en: The vase sits on a wooden stand.
ex.ko: 꽃병은 나무 받침대 위에 놓여 있다.

easy: What a thing is made from.

ex.en: Plastic is the stuff this toy is made of.
ex.ko: 이 장난감은 플라스틱으로 만들어졌다.

easy: A bunch of things when you do not say exactly what they are.

ex.en: My backpack is full of stuff for school.
ex.ko: 내 가방은 학교 준비물로 가득 차 있다.

easy: The things that belong to you.

ex.en: Grab your stuff, the bus is here!
ex.ko: 네 물건 챙겨, 버스 왔어!

easy: How much money there is.

ex.en: Grandpa gave me a small amount of money for my birthday.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 내 생일에 적은 금액의 돈을 주셨다.

easy: How much of something there is.

ex.en: Drink a good amount of water after sports.
ex.ko: 운동한 뒤에는 물을 충분한 양 마셔라.

easy: How many or how much of something you can count or measure.

ex.en: The amount of snow last winter was huge.
ex.ko: 지난겨울에는 눈이 엄청나게 많이 왔다.

easy: The color of a clear sky on a sunny day.

ex.en: The sky was bright blue.
ex.ko: 하늘이 아주 파랬다.

easy: Feeling sad and low.

ex.en: I felt blue when my best friend moved away.
ex.ko: 가장 친한 친구가 이사 가서 나는 우울했다.

easy: To make a car or bus go where you want.

ex.en: Mom drives the car to school every morning.
ex.ko: 엄마는 매일 아침 차를 운전해서 학교에 간다.

easy: To go somewhere in a car.

ex.en: We drove to the beach on Saturday.
ex.ko: 우리는 토요일에 차를 타고 해변에 갔다.

easy: To take someone somewhere in a car.

ex.en: Dad drove me to soccer practice.
ex.ko: 아빠가 나를 축구 연습장에 차로 데려다주셨다.

easy: To put food in your mouth and swallow it.

ex.en: I eat cereal every morning.
ex.ko: 나는 매일 아침 시리얼을 먹는다.

easy: To have breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

ex.en: We eat dinner together every night.
ex.ko: 우리는 매일 밤 함께 저녁을 먹는다.

easy: What animals do when they take in food.

ex.en: The horse eats hay in the barn.
ex.ko: 말은 마구간에서 건초를 먹는다.

easy: To drop down to the ground.

ex.en: Apples fall from the tree in autumn.
ex.ko: 가을에는 사과가 나무에서 떨어진다.

easy: To go down to a lower place or number.

ex.en: The temperature falls at night.
ex.ko: 밤에는 기온이 내려간다.

easy: To slowly or suddenly get into a new state.

ex.en: The baby fell asleep in the car.
ex.ko: 아기는 차 안에서 잠이 들었다.

easy: Able to move or do things in a very short time.

ex.en: A cheetah is the fastest animal on land.
ex.ko: 치타는 땅에서 가장 빠른 동물이다.

easy: Showing a time that is later than the real time.

ex.en: My watch is five minutes fast.
ex.ko: 내 시계는 5분 빠르다.

easy: Played or said with quick beats.

ex.en: I love fast songs that make me dance.
ex.ko: 나는 춤추게 만드는 빠른 노래가 좋다.

easy: What you feel inside, like happy or sad.

ex.en: I had a happy feeling on the last day of school.
ex.ko: 학교 마지막 날에 나는 행복한 기분이 들었다.

easy: An idea in your mind that you are not totally sure about.

ex.en: I have a feeling it will rain today.
ex.ko: 오늘 비가 올 것 같은 느낌이 든다.

easy: The mood you sense in a place.

ex.en: The feeling in the library was quiet and calm.
ex.ko: 도서관의 분위기는 조용하고 차분했다.

easy: The color of fresh grass.

ex.en: The grass is bright green after the rain.
ex.ko: 비가 온 뒤 풀이 선명한 초록색이다.

easy: Not ready to eat yet, not ripe.

ex.en: The green bananas are still hard.
ex.ko: 초록색 바나나는 아직 덜 익어서 딱딱하다.

easy: A group of sports teams that play against each other.

ex.en: My brother plays in a baseball league.
ex.ko: 우리 형은 야구 리그에서 뛴다.

easy: A group of people or countries that join together for a goal.

ex.en: The countries formed a league to protect the ocean.
ex.ko: 그 나라들은 바다를 지키기 위해 연맹을 만들었다.

easy: Taking care of something and deciding how it is run.

ex.en: Good management keeps the school running smoothly.
ex.ko: 좋은 관리 덕분에 학교가 잘 돌아간다.

easy: The people who run a store or company.

ex.en: The store management said the sale ends Friday.
ex.ko: 상점 경영진은 할인 행사가 금요일에 끝난다고 말했다.

easy: A small stick you rub to make a flame.

ex.en: Dad struck a match to light the candle.
ex.ko: 아빠는 성냥을 그어 초에 불을 붙이셨다.

easy: A game where two people or teams try to win.

ex.en: Our tennis match lasted two hours.
ex.ko: 우리의 테니스 시합은 두 시간 동안 이어졌다.

easy: A photo or drawing that shows how something looks.

ex.en: Dad took a picture of us at the beach.
ex.ko: 아빠는 해변에서 우리 사진을 찍으셨다.

easy: A drawing made with paint.

ex.en: Lia painted a picture of a sunset.
ex.ko: 리아는 노을 그림을 그렸다.

easy: How big or small something is.

ex.en: The size of an elephant is huge.
ex.ko: 코끼리는 크기가 어마어마하다.

easy: A number or letter that tells how big clothes or shoes are.

ex.en: My shoe size is four.
ex.ko: 내 신발 사이즈는 4이다.

easy: One thing you do as part of a bigger plan.

ex.en: The first step is to wash your hands.
ex.ko: 첫 번째 단계는 손을 씻는 것이다.

easy: The space you cover when you take one step.

ex.en: The tree is ten steps from the gate.
ex.ko: 그 나무는 대문에서 열 걸음 떨어져 있다.

easy: Lifting one foot and putting it down to move.

ex.en: The baby took her first step today.
ex.ko: 아기가 오늘 첫걸음을 뗐다.

easy: Believing that someone is honest and will not let you down.

ex.en: A good friend earns your trust by keeping secrets.
ex.ko: 좋은 친구는 비밀을 지켜서 너의 믿음을 얻는다.

easy: Very important and necessary.

ex.en: Honesty is a central rule in our home.
ex.ko: 정직은 우리 집의 핵심 규칙이다.

easy: In the middle of something.

ex.en: The library is in a central spot in our town.
ex.ko: 도서관은 우리 마을의 중심에 있다.

easy: Toward the front.

ex.en: The dog ran forward to catch the ball.
ex.ko: 강아지는 공을 잡으려고 앞으로 달려갔다.

easy: A small metal tool that opens a lock.

ex.en: I lost my house key at the park.
ex.ko: 나는 공원에서 우리 집 열쇠를 잃어버렸다.

easy: The most important thing that helps you understand or do something.

ex.en: Practice is the key to getting better at piano.
ex.ko: 연습이 피아노 실력을 키우는 비결이다.

easy: A word kids use for their mother.

ex.en: My mom packs my lunch every day.
ex.ko: 엄마는 매일 내 점심 도시락을 싸 주신다.

easy: One side of a sheet of paper in a book.

ex.en: Turn to page ten in your book.
ex.ko: 책 10쪽을 펴라.

easy: Getting money for the work you do.

ex.en: Dad has a paid job at the hospital.
ex.ko: 아빠는 병원에서 돈을 받는 일을 하신다.

easy: How far or how wide something can reach.

ex.en: A piano plays a wide range of notes.
ex.ko: 피아노는 넓은 범위의 음을 연주한다.

easy: A big open field of grass where farm animals eat.

ex.en: Cows eat grass on the open range.
ex.ko: 소들은 탁 트인 목초지에서 풀을 먹는다.

easy: Looking at something again to check it.

ex.en: Our coach did a review of the game video.
ex.ko: 코치님은 경기 영상을 다시 검토하셨다.

easy: Writing that tells what someone thinks about a book or movie.

ex.en: I read a review of the movie before we watched it.
ex.ko: 나는 영화를 보기 전에 그 영화의 평론을 읽었다.

easy: A type of study that learns facts about the world.

ex.en: Biology is a science about living things.
ex.ko: 생물학은 살아 있는 것들을 배우는 과학이다.

easy: Of many different kinds.

ex.en: The store sells various kinds of candy.
ex.ko: 그 가게는 여러 가지 사탕을 판다.

easy: Thinking hard about one thing and watching it closely.

ex.en: Please pay attention to the teacher.
ex.ko: 선생님께 주의를 기울이세요.

easy: When people want to look at you or know about you.

ex.en: The new puppy got all the attention.
ex.ko: 새 강아지가 모든 관심을 받았다.

easy: A boy who has the same mom and dad as you.

ex.en: My brother and I play games after school.
ex.ko: 형과 나는 방과 후에 게임을 한다.

easy: A small thing you drink from.

ex.en: Pour the milk into the cup.
ex.ko: 우유를 컵에 따르세요.

easy: As much as one cup can hold.

ex.en: Add one cup of flour to the bowl.
ex.ko: 그릇에 밀가루 한 컵을 넣으세요.

easy: A game where two teams try to move a ball into the other team's goal.

ex.en: We watch football on Sunday with Dad.
ex.ko: 우리는 일요일에 아빠와 함께 풋볼 경기를 본다.

easy: The oval ball used in the game of American football.

ex.en: Jake threw the football across the field.
ex.ko: 제이크는 운동장 건너편으로 풋볼을 던졌다.

easy: To not like something at all.

ex.en: I hate cleaning my room.
ex.ko: 나는 내 방 청소하는 것이 정말 싫다.

easy: A very strong feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: Hate makes people do unkind things.
ex.ko: 증오는 사람들이 못된 행동을 하게 만든다.

easy: To move something down to a lower place.

ex.en: Lower the flag at sunset.
ex.ko: 해질 때 깃발을 내려라.

easy: To make a number or price smaller.

ex.en: The store will lower the price of toys.
ex.ko: 그 가게는 장난감 가격을 낮출 것이다.

easy: To make a sound softer.

ex.en: Please lower the TV, the baby is sleeping.
ex.ko: 아기가 자고 있으니 TV 소리를 줄여 주세요.

easy: What you would expect to happen, nothing strange.

ex.en: It is natural to feel nervous on the first day of school.
ex.ko: 학교 첫날 긴장하는 것은 자연스러운 일이다.

easy: Made by nature, not made by people.

ex.en: The ring has a natural pearl.
ex.ko: 그 반지에는 천연 진주가 박혀 있다.

easy: The tenth month of the year.

ex.en: We carve pumpkins in October.
ex.ko: 우리는 10월에 호박을 조각한다.

easy: How good something is.

ex.en: This backpack is good quality.
ex.ko: 이 가방은 품질이 좋다.

easy: To make something go to another place.

ex.en: The teacher sent a note home to our parents.
ex.ko: 선생님은 우리 부모님께 쪽지를 집으로 보내셨다.

easy: To make a letter or message go to someone far away.

ex.en: I will send a package to my grandma.
ex.ko: 나는 할머니께 소포를 보낼 것이다.

easy: The special way a person does or makes something.

ex.en: She paints in a colorful style.
ex.ko: 그녀는 화려한 스타일로 그림을 그린다.

easy: A kind of something, based on how it looks.

ex.en: This style of shoe comes in red.
ex.ko: 이 스타일의 신발은 빨간색도 있다.

easy: Very surprising.

ex.en: The magician did an amazing trick.
ex.ko: 마술사는 놀라운 마술을 보여 주었다.

easy: So wonderful that it makes you stare in wonder.

ex.en: The Grand Canyon is an amazing sight.
ex.ko: 그랜드 캐니언은 정말 굉장한 풍경이다.

easy: The red liquid inside your body that your heart pumps.

ex.en: Your heart pumps blood through your body.
ex.ko: 심장은 온몸으로 피를 보낸다.

easy: Fancy white plates and cups that break easily.

ex.en: Grandma's china teapot has little flowers on it.
ex.ko: 할머니의 도자기 찻주전자에는 작은 꽃이 그려져 있다.

easy: Fancy plates and cups used for special meals.

ex.en: We use the fancy china at Thanksgiving.
ex.ko: 우리는 추수감사절에 좋은 도자기 그릇을 쓴다.

easy: Having all the parts it needs.

ex.en: A complete breakfast has fruit, eggs, and toast.
ex.ko: 완전한 아침 식사에는 과일, 달걀, 토스트가 있다.

easy: A pet animal that barks and wags its tail.

ex.en: My dog wags his tail when I get home.
ex.ko: 내가 집에 오면 우리 개는 꼬리를 흔든다.

easy: Having to do with money, jobs, and how a country earns and spends.

ex.en: Economic news is about money and jobs.
ex.ko: 경제 뉴스는 돈과 일자리에 관한 이야기이다.

easy: Taking part in something or being connected to it.

ex.en: Every kid involved in the play got a hug.
ex.ko: 연극에 참여한 모든 아이들이 포옹을 받았다.

easy: The words people use to talk and write with each other.

ex.en: I speak Korean and English, two languages.
ex.ko: 나는 한국어와 영어, 두 가지 언어를 말한다.
